title: Blood magic
content:
# Blood magic

# Introduction

Blood magic is a weapon class which was added in the Mistlands update.
To cast any spell with a Blood Magic type weapon costs the user some health. The cost is a set amount in percent, relating to the users current health (thus it is not possible to kill yourself by using the weapon).

## List of blood weapons

• Name: Staff of Protection | Eitr used: 60 | Health drained: 40% | Hp/Shield: 200 | Damage: 0 | Duration: 1/2/3/4 minutes per Staff level | Limit max Summon: 1 per ally

• Name: Dead Raiser | Eitr used: 100 | Health drained: 40% | Hp/Shield: 400 | Damage: Summon: 50 slash/40 pierce | Duration: Unlimited | Limit max Summon: Up to 4 based on Dead Raiser level

• Name: Trollstav | Eitr used: 120 | Health drained: 60% | Hp/Shield: 2000 | Damage: On cast: 300 fire, 50 pure Summon: 60-80 blunt | Duration: Unlimited | Limit max Summon: 2

Categorias: Weapons, Blood magic, Magic
